name: DeepSeek Harness + V4-Flash — agentic development on your GPUs
description: Run DeepSeek Harness with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 against a persistent git workspace. The returned ocean-node HTTP URL opens the authenticated browser UI directly; the bootstrap patches the pinned harness's insecure-origin UUID bug, so workspace selection and sessions work without a self-signed HTTPS workaround. Optionally clone a public or private HTTPS repository at launch. The same endpoint exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1 API protected by a separate bearer key, allowing a harness on your own computer to keep the repository local. Six built-in skills cover the service, model, GPU budget, git workflow, ocean templates and harness extensions. A persistent bucket, a web password and a model API key are required.
outcome: Develop in a cloned git repository from the browser UI or use the rented model from a harness on your computer.

workflows.name: Persistent model, sessions and git workspace
workflows.description: This empty workflow makes the launch UI request a persistent bucket. The container stores the model cache, harness state and git workspace there and refuses to start without it.

requiredResources.description: Requires 2, 4 or 8 H200-class GPUs on one host and a large operator-configured /dev/shm. Two 141 GB H200s are the measured minimum; four provide safer context and quantization headroom.
